sections.title: Memphis Industry Specializations
sections.description: Deep expertise in Memphis's key industry verticals.

blocks.heading: Logistics (FedEx's World Hub)
paragraphs: FedEx Express (Memphis HQ) operates Memphis International Airport as the world's largest cargo airport by air freight volume — the SuperHub processes approximately 1.5 million packages per night:

Package sortation optimization: ML for FedEx's enormous Memphis SuperHub operations — package flow optimization, sort assignment, and exception handling for the millions of packages processed nightly through Memphis's massive automated sortation systems.

Delivery route optimization: Last-mile route optimization for FedEx Ground's Memphis-area delivery operations — incorporating Memphis's specific geography (Mississippi River, major industrial corridors, residential density patterns).

Network capacity analytics: Demand forecasting and capacity planning for FedEx's air network — predicting volume surges (holiday, e-commerce, medical shipments) and optimizing aircraft utilization across FedEx's global air fleet.
Cost: $55,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | FedEx network context

blocks.heading: Healthcare
paragraphs: Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare (Memphis HQ, 6 hospitals), Baptist Memorial Health Care (Memphis HQ, 22 hospitals across the Mid-South), and St. Jude Children's Research Hospital (Memphis, one of the world's leading children's cancer research hospitals):

St. Jude clinical research AI: ML for St. Jude's world-renowned pediatric oncology research — clinical trial analytics, treatment response prediction, and cancer genomics analysis. St. Jude's mission (ensuring no family pays for treatment) creates specific clinical AI requirements emphasizing research advancement.
Regional health system AI: HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for Methodist Le Bonheur and Baptist Memorial's large Mid-South hospital networks.
Tennessee Medicaid (TennCare) analytics: Population health ML for the managed care organizations serving Tennessee's TennCare Medicaid program.
Cost: $50,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | HIPAA, TennCare context

blocks.heading: Manufacturing
paragraphs: International Paper (Memphis HQ, world's largest paper and packaging company), AutoZone (Memphis HQ, largest US auto parts retailer):

Paper manufacturing process AI: ML for International Paper's pulp and paper manufacturing operations — process optimization, quality prediction, and energy efficiency analytics for IP's large mill operations.

AutoZone supply chain: Demand forecasting and inventory optimization for AutoZone's 6,000+ US store network — auto parts demand prediction incorporating vehicle age data, regional driving patterns, and seasonal maintenance cycles.
Cost: $40,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Mid-South Agriculture
paragraphs: Memphis is the commercial center of the Mississippi Delta agricultural economy:
Cotton, soybean, and rice yield prediction for Mississippi Delta farmers.
Agricultural commodity price analytics for Mid-South commodity traders.
Food processing optimization for the grain elevator and cotton gin operations surrounding Memphis.
Cost: $25,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks

blocks.heading: FedEx's technology modernization

St. Jude's AI and informatics programs represent some of the most consequential clinical research AI being developed anywhere in the US.
